proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL builds an a3k['image'] gradient sprite with +x offset added to the healthbar group, and SERVED repeats the same image/position/opacity setup; it is the left-side gradient panel mirrored by a3p on the right.

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL var a3m=0x12c feeds HL width/position tweens and healthUpdateTime=a3m*2, and SERVED shows the identical 0x12c init with the same tween/time multiplications; it is the health-bar animation duration.
proposals.name: healthAnimDuration

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL takes getContext('2d') of the red-gradient image, sets fillStyle/fillRect, and is reused for redGradientRight; SERVED shows the same getContext/fill calls, so it is the 2d context used to tint gradients.
proposals.name: gradientCtx

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL computes maxwidth*health/maxHealth and passes it as the HL width-tween target; SERVED repeats the same maxwidth-ratio computation and tween calls, so it is the target health-bar width.

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL is the for-loop counter indexing gradient stops a3l, and SERVED repeats the same a3l-indexing loop; the token is reused as a plain loop counter across setup loops on both sides. [merger: loopIndex collides with a rename-map value; variant loopPosition]

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL loops Kq['chats'] indexing chat entries for fade/timeout updates, and SERVED repeats the same chats loop with identical indexing; it is the chat-list index.

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL builds the mirrored gradient image with -x offset added to fbgKsskemj alongside redGradientRight, and SERVED repeats the same mirrored image/position/opacity setup; right-side counterpart of a3m.

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL saves this['max']['parent'] before rebuilding the max-ammo label and re-adds via a3p['add']; SERVED shows the same parent-save/remove/re-add sequence, so it is the ammo label's parent container.

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL sets 0xf paired with a3q as the health-bar rect height; SERVED repeats the same 0xf init and rect-height uses, so it is the health-bar height.

proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL computes timeLeft-(Date.now()-Lc) then decomposes into d/h/m/s for the 'Resets In' text; SERVED repeats the same timeLeft math and countdown decomposition, so it is the remaining-time milliseconds.
